profile.summary: Galileo Learning runs summer camps and expanded learning programs for kids in kindergarten through 10th grade. The programs focus on hands-on STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts and math) projects and outdoor play. The company began in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2002 and now runs programs at more than 60 locations in several states.

review.notes: The California privacy notice names Galileo Learning, LLC with a postal address at 1021 3rd Street, Oakland, matching the agenda's Oakland location, and the site describes summer and expanded-learning camps with Oakland school sites. The summary, website, phone and headquarters are all shown in the cited sources and the summary is neutral.
